values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754449 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists primitive campsites, a toilet and a hand launch; 'Difficult Accessibility'. Site is 16.2 acres.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754449 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Hand Launch', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'; Size '16.2 acres'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Clearwater River with designated primitive camping (Region 2). Directions (FWP): 30 miles east of Bonner on Hwy 200, or 0.5 miles west of Clearwater Junction. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping (with/without fishing license), 30-ft trailer limit, 7-day stay limit (added to booking), primitive campsites, toilet, hand launch; open-all-year season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left). Note trimmed of the restated facilities, length, stay limit, FCFS and fee text.
